2607.12678.title: Text-Aided Multi-Modal Panoptic Symbol Spotting for CAD Floor Plan Drawings
2607.12678.paper_summary: Computer-Aided Design (CAD) floor plan drawings contain both graphical primitives and textual annotations, which provide complementary geometric and semantic cues for intelligent design understanding. Among CAD analysis tasks, panoptic symbol spotting has become increasingly important with the growing demand for industrial digitalization and deep learning-based automation. However, most existing methods remain primarily primitive-centric and underexploit textual annotations, despite their critical semantic value. Even the few text-aware approaches often treat annotations only superficially, without properly modeling complex syntax and hierarchical semantics of CAD annotations, which leads to semantic loss and suboptimal spotting performance. To address these limitations, we propose TextCAD, a multimodal framework that jointly models graphical primitives and textual annotations for panoptic symbol spotting. Specifically, we design a Type-Attribute Correlation Encoder (TACE) to explicitly encode the compositional semantics within annotations by jointly modeling their types and attributes. We further introduce a Semantic Hierarchy Alignment framework with Multi-level Semantic Filtering (MSF) and primitive downsampling, which adaptively aligns annotation semantics with graphical primitives at different semantic levels and enables accurate cross-modal semantic injection and fusion. Experiments on real-world building-design datasets show that TextCAD effectively improves symbol spotting performance and achieves state-of-the-art results.
2607.12678.paper_summary_zh: 電腦輔助設計（CAD）平面圖繪製包含圖形原語和文本註釋，這些提供了補充的幾何和語義提示，以促進智能設計理解。<lb/>在CAD分析任務中，全面符號識別隨著工業數字化和基於深度學習的自動化需求的增長而變得越來越重要。<lb/>然而，大多數現有方法仍然主要以原語為中心，並未充分利用文本註釋，儘管它們具有關鍵的語義價值。<lb/>即使是少數的文本感知方法也往往只是表面上處理註釋，未能正確建模CAD註釋的複雜語法和層次語義，這導致了語義損失和次優的識別性能。<lb/>為了解決這些限制，我們提出了TextCAD，一個多模態框架，該框架共同建模圖形原語和文本註釋以進行全面符號識別。<lb/>具體而言，我們設計了一個類型-屬性關聯編碼器（TACE），以明確編碼註釋中的組合語義，通過共同建模它們的類型和屬性。<lb/>我們進一步引入了一個語義層次對齊框架，配合多層語義過濾（MSF）和原語下採樣，該框架自適應地將註釋語義與不同語義層次的圖形原語對齊，並實現準確的跨模態語義注入和融合。<lb/>在實際建築設計數據集上的實驗顯示，TextCAD有效提高了符號識別性能，並達到了最先進的結果。
